title: Towards AI-Driven Nanomedicine Discovery: A Benchmark and Multimodal Learning Framework for Nano Self-Assembly Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.04278v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Nano self-assembly organizes molecular components into bioactive nanoscale structures. Self-assembled nanoparticles (NAPs) derived from Chinese herbal formulas and applications such as anti-lung-cancer therapy demonstrate the substantial potential of self-assembly for nanomedicine discovery. Yet discovery still relies on costly wet-lab screening, while existing machine learning approaches lack standardized tasks, effective pairwise compatibility modeling, and public benchmarks with unified evaluation. To address these limitations, we formalize NSA prediction as a binary classification task for predicting self-assembly between molecular pairs and then establish NSA-Bench, the first public benchmark with curated molecular combinations, experimental conditions, self-assembly labels, and standardized evaluation protocols. We further develop NSA-Net, an interaction-aware multimodal framework that integrates complementary molecular evidence

translated_title: 迈向AI驱动的纳米药物发现：用于纳米自组装预测的基准与多模态学习框架
translated_abstract: 纳米自组装是将分子组件组织成具有生物活性的纳米级结构的过程。源自中药配方的自组装纳米粒子及其在抗肺癌治疗等方面的应用，展示了自组装在纳米药物发现领域的巨大潜力。然而，当前的发现过程仍然依赖昂贵的湿实验筛选，而现有的机器学习方法缺乏标准化的任务定义、有效的分子对兼容性建模，以及具有统一评估协议的公开基准。为解决这些局限性，我们将纳米自组装预测形式化为一个二元分类任务，用于预测分子对之间是否发生自组装，并据此建立了NSA-Bench——首个公开的基准数据集，其中包含精心整理的分子组合、实验条件、自组装标签以及标准化的评估协议。我们进一步开发了NSA-Net，这是一个感知交互的多模态框架，能够整合互补的分子证据。
tldr: 该论文建立了首个纳米自组装预测公开基准NSA-Bench，并提出感知交互的多模态学习框架NSA-Net，推动AI驱动的纳米药物发现。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NSA-Bench, the first public benchmark for nano self-assembly prediction, along with NSA-Net, an interaction-aware multimodal learning framework, advancing AI-driven nanomedicine discovery.
